role_permissions_select.name: role_permissions_select
role_permissions_select.using: exists (select 1 from roles r where r.id = role_permissions.role_id)

roles_select.name: roles_select
roles_select.using: organization_id is null or organization_id = (select app.current_org_id())

admission_requests_public_insert.name: admission_requests_public_insert
admission_requests_public_insert.withCheck:
organization_id = (select app.current_org_id())
        and "admission_requests"."origin" = 'landing'
        and "admission_requests"."status" = 'new'
        and "admission_requests"."created_by" is null
        and "admission_requests"."updated_by" is null
        and "admission_requests"."internal_notes" is null
        and "admission_requests"."converted_admission_id" is null
        and "admission_requests"."discard_reason" is null
        and "admission_requests"."version" = 1

admission_requests_discard_check.name: admission_requests_discard_check
admission_requests_discard_check.value:
("admission_requests"."status" = 'discarded') = ("admission_requests"."discard_reason" is not null)
        and ("admission_requests"."discard_reason" is null or "admission_requests"."discard_reason" in ('no_vacancy', 'requirements', 'withdrew', 'duplicate', 'spam', 'other'))

admission_requests_consent_check.name: admission_requests_consent_check
admission_requests_consent_check.value: "admission_requests"."origin" <> 'landing' or ("admission_requests"."consent_accepted_at" is not null and "admission_requests"."consent_text_version" is not null)

audit_events_public_insert.name: audit_events_public_insert
audit_events_public_insert.withCheck:
organization_id = (select app.current_org_id())
        and "audit_events"."actor_user_id" is null
        and "audit_events"."action" = 'admission_request.created'
        and "audit_events"."entity_type" = 'admission_request'

domain_events_public_insert.name: domain_events_public_insert
domain_events_public_insert.withCheck:
organization_id = (select app.current_org_id())
        and "domain_events"."type" = 'admission_request.created'
        and "domain_events"."entity_type" = 'admission_request'
        and "domain_events"."processed_at" is null

fee_payments_void_check.name: fee_payments_void_check

("fee_payments"."voided_at" is null and "fee_payments"."voided_by" is null and "fee_payments"."void_reason" is null)
        or ("fee_payments"."voided_at" is not null and "fee_payments"."voided_by" is not null and length(trim("fee_payments"."void_reason")) > 0)

resident_notes_resolution_check.name: resident_notes_resolution_check
resident_notes_resolution_check.value:
("resident_notes"."resolved_at" is null and "resident_notes"."resolved_by" is null and "resident_notes"."resolution_note" is null)
        or ("resident_notes"."follow_up" and "resident_notes"."resolved_at" is not null and "resident_notes"."resolved_by" is not null)

shift_handovers_note_check.name: shift_handovers_note_check
shift_handovers_note_check.value: "shift_handovers"."note" is null or length(trim("shift_handovers"."note")) between 1 and 1000

notifications_select.name: notifications_select
notifications_select.using: organization_id = (select app.current_org_id()) and (recipient_user_id = (select app.current_user_id()) or (select app.current_user_id()) is null)

residents_discharge_check.name: residents_discharge_check
residents_discharge_check.value: ("residents"."status" = 'discharged') = ("residents"."discharge_date" is not null and "residents"."discharge_reason" is not null)

organizations_select.name: organizations_select
organizations_select.using:
id = (select app.current_org_id()) or exists (
        select 1 from organization_memberships m
        where m.organization_id = organizations.id
          and m.user_id = (select app.current_user_id())
          and m.status = 'active'
      )

sites_public_slug_check.name: sites_public_slug_check
sites_public_slug_check.value: "sites"."public_slug" is null or ("sites"."public_slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' and length("sites"."public_slug") between 3 and 60)
